# std.random

<!-- Generated by `lang doc std` from the checked interfaces (lang 0.1.0). Do not edit by hand. -->

Explicit random sources. A seeded source is deterministic, so tests can
control randomness; an OS-seeded source is an explicit `State` effect.

## Types

### `Random`

```lang

```


#### `Random.float`

```lang
fn float(self: &Self) -> Float !{State}
```

A float in `[0, 1)`.

#### `Random.int`

```lang
fn int(self: &Self, low: Int, high: Int) -> Int !{State}
```

A uniformly distributed integer in `low..high`.

## Functions

### `seeded`

```lang
fn seeded(seed: Int) -> Random
```

A deterministic source.

### `system`

```lang
fn system() -> Random !{State}
```

A source seeded from the clock and process id.
